description: Hear Your TV Better The Bose TV Speaker is a one-step, simple solution for better TV sound. It’s small but powerful, delivering a clear, balanced and natural-sounding audio experience that enhances dialogue and bass performance. * This Bose TV Speaker image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. EXPLORE THE FEATURES Simple setup A single connection to your TV has you up and running in no time. Acoustic performance Two full-range drivers are angled to deliver wide, spatial sound, while the centre tweeter clarifies speech for clear dialogue. Wireless music The Bose TV Speaker can wirelessly stream content from any Bluetooth device. Small size At just over 5 cm tall, the Bose TV Speaker is a small soundbar that fits just about anywhere. Wall bracket available. Enhanced clarity You can also place the Bose TV Speaker in Dialogue mode to further enhance the clarity of speech, conversations and news programmes. Visual confirmation Small LED lights turn on and/or change colour when certain features are enabled. They also blink to acknowledge volume changes. * This Bose TV Speaker image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. More Music The Bose TV Speaker
